title: End to end
sub: In the weeds of data crafting, a technical series for analytics engineers: one new consumer, Finance, taken through the ten steps in a real project, one commit per step. The files that arrive to stay, the ones that change, the temporary ones deleted when the work is done; every file in a home named for its domain, so a domain can move out to a project of its own.
howto: White lines on blue are the model; code on dark glass is a file in the project, as that step's commit left it. Along the top, the ten commits fill in as the steps are taken. A file that arrives is marked +, one that changes ~, one that's deleted −; temporary files are drawn dashed. Teal is an AI agent's work; gold is a person's approval.
